summary: Iteration-3 e2e testing (backend + frontend) of SAPA. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration3.py (10 cases) - GET /rooms/{id}/booked (shape {checkin,checkout} only, public, unknown room -> [], includes a newly created range, excludes cancelled bookings, other rooms unaffected, consistent with /availability true/false), GET /bookings/{id}/receipt (401 without token, 400 'hanya tersedia untuk booking yang sudah Lunas' when unpaid, 404 unknown id, 200 application/pdf starting with %PDF + Content-Disposition attachment after PATCH /payment paid, back to 400 after reverting to unpaid), PATCH /payment invalid status -> 400. All 10 pass. Full suite: 64 passed + 1 xfail (brute-force lockout still missing) across backend_test.py + test_iteration2.py + test_iteration3.py. PDF content verified by decoding the ASCII85/Flate streams: 'KWITANSI PEMBAYARAN', guest name, phone, method, Status LUNAS, room + date range + days, addon line, TOTAL Rp 2.750.000, footer - plus an embedded /Image XObject (the Kaltara logo). Frontend (Playwright, public URL): header shows /logo-kaltara.png (naturalWidth 512) and admin-logo-btn still opens the Akses Admin modal; Meeting Room modal fetched booked ranges and rendered 3 'Tanggal penuh' booked-range chips, and Oct-2026 days 5/6/7 were disabled while day 8 (checkout day) stayed selectable; admin dashboard: receipt-btn + wa-guest render ONLY on the Lunas row (absent on the unpaid row), receipt-btn triggered a real download kwitansi-32B33EB1.pdf (123771 bytes, %PDF header) with toast 'Kwitansi diunduh', payment-toggle Belum->Lunas persisted after reload and opened a WhatsApp tab addressed to the GUEST number (wa.me/6281298765432 -> api.whatsapp.com redirect) with the LUNAS message, standalone wa-guest button opens the same link; regression guest flow: Ballroom 18-20 Nov 2026 -> avail-ok Tersedia -> add to cart -> checkout -> success view with order-ref 549F0846, WhatsApp button and Upload Bukti Pembayaran, and re-opening Ballroom then showed the new '18 Nov 2026 - 20 Nov 2026' booked chip. All test bookings deleted afterwards - bookings collection is empty (0).

minor.issue: Returns ALL non-cancelled ranges including fully past ones (verified: a 2020-01-01..03 booking is listed). The guest 'Tanggal penuh' chip list therefore grows unbounded and shows expired dates. Filter checkout >= today server-side (and sort/limit).
Accepts past check-in dates - payload with checkin 2020-01-01 returned 200 and created a booking (frontend blocks it, API does not). Validate checkin >= today.
Only payment_status is checked; a booking with status='cancelled' but payment_status='paid' still produces a valid kwitansi PDF. Should refuse (or watermark) cancelled bookings.
Every PDF is ~123 KB because the full 512x512 logo-kaltara.png is embedded uncompressed (PDF size == logo size). Downscale/re-encode the logo once at startup to keep receipts small.
Carried over: no brute-force lockout/rate limiting (6 wrong passwords -> 6x401, valid login still works). test_brute_force_lockout xfails.
Carried over: allow_credentials=True with CORS_ORIGINS='*'; preflight returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin '*' and no Allow-Credentials header. Use explicit origins.
Carried over from iteration 2: intra-payload overlap not detected, client-supplied totals trusted, settings body is an unvalidated dict.

ui_bugs.issue: The temporary <a> is never appended to the DOM and URL.revokeObjectURL() is called synchronously right after a.click(). Works in Chromium (verified) but Firefox/Safari commonly cancel such downloads. Append to document.body and revoke in a setTimeout / after 'click'.

Request uses responseType:'blob', so on an error the axios response body is a Blob and apiErr() cannot read `detail` - the user gets the generic 'Gagal membuat kwitansi' instead of the backend reason (e.g. booking no longer Lunas in another tab).
Booked (penuh) days use exactly the same muted/disabled style as past days - a guest cannot tell why a date is unselectable, and there is no legend/tooltip. Consider a red strike/dot for booked days.
Chips render every booked range (incl. far-future and past) with no cap or 'lihat semua' - the block can become very long for a busy room.
Carried over: booking delete, room delete and settings reset still use native window.confirm() instead of Shadcn AlertDialog.
Carried over a11y console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' on the room modal and admin login modal.

integration_issues.issue: notifyGuestPaid uses window.open on a click handler chained after an await (togglePaid awaits the PATCH before calling it). Chromium allowed it here, but browsers with strict popup blocking may treat it as a non-user-gesture popup and silently block the WA tab; there is no fallback link/toast if window.open returns null.
Carried over: cart items are not re-validated against availability at checkout time; the room modal is the only gate and two overlapping items in one payload are accepted by the API.

issues: Carried over: Sonner toast renders top-right directly over the Logout button while visible (screenshot admin_dashboard_i3.png).
The 'Booking Berhasil' sheet title is covered by the success toast at the top-right (screenshot guest_success_i3.png).

'PENDAPATAN (CONFIRMED/DONE)' showed Rp 0 while the 'Pendapatan per Ruangan' bar tooltip showed Rp 4.500.000 for the same pending bookings - the chart aggregates all statuses under the same 'Pendapatan' label; confusing/inconsistent.

action_items: Filter past ranges out of GET /rooms/{id}/booked (checkout >= today) so the 'Tanggal penuh' chips and disabled dates only show relevant bookings.
Reject past check-in dates in POST /api/bookings (server-side date validation).
Block the kwitansi for cancelled bookings (status != 'cancelled' in addition to payment_status == 'paid').
Shrink the logo used in build_receipt_pdf (currently makes every receipt ~123 KB).
Harden downloadReceipt: append the anchor to the DOM, revoke the object URL asynchronously, and read the error blob to show the real backend message.
Give booked days a distinct visual treatment (vs past days) in the check-in/check-out calendars, plus a legend.
Handle window.open returning null after the await in togglePaid/notifyGuestPaid (fallback anchor + toast).

Carried over: brute-force lockout, explicit CORS origins, Pydantic schema for PUT /settings, server-side totals, intra-payload overlap check, AlertDialog instead of window.confirm, DialogDescription for a11y, migrate @app.on_event to lifespan.
critical_code_review_comments: build_receipt_pdf does synchronous file IO / image decoding inside an async endpoint - wrap in run_in_threadpool for large receipts under load.
Overlap detection is still duplicated between /availability, /rooms/{id}/booked and POST /bookings - extract one helper.
GET /rooms/{room_id}/booked has .to_list(2000) with no date filter or projection limit; combine with the past-date filter and a cap.
The receipt PDF discloses guest name and phone; it is admin-authenticated (verified 401 without token) - keep it that way and never expose it via a public link.
Iteration-2 fix confirmed: RoomDetailModal.toISO() now uses local getFullYear/getMonth/getDate, so the UTC+7 off-by-one date bug is resolved.

success_rate.backend: 100% of iteration-3 cases (10/10); full suite 64 passed / 1 xfail
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested flows functional; 6 minor UI defects + 2 integration risks + 3 design issues found

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/ -q (pytest.ini sets -n 2 --dist loadscope). test_iteration3.py covers /rooms/{id}/booked + receipt PDF and self-cleans via the `created` fixture; POST /api/bookings returns only {count, group_id} - resolve ids via GET /api/bookings and match group_id (helper booking_ids_for_group). BookingItem requires days/base_price/room_total/addons_total/notes/total (not nights/price_per_night). Use /app/backend/tests/_ui3_seed.py {seed|cleanup|list} to prepare UI data. Receipt download is capturable via page.expect_download(). WA popups: register page.context.on('page', ...) - wa.me redirects to api.whatsapp.com so assert on 'whatsapp' not just 'wa.me'. Container date is 2026-08-28, so use Oct/Nov 2026 for near-term UI dates and 2039+ for far-future.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect in the iteration-3 features - all four (booked endpoint, kwitansi PDF, guest WA confirmation, Kaltara logo) work end-to-end. Root causes of the reported minors: (1) booked_ranges/create_booking have no date-floor filter, so past bookings stay in the availability domain forever; (2) booking_receipt validates only payment_status, ignoring status='cancelled'; (3) reportlab embeds the source PNG as-is, so the 123 KB logo dominates every receipt; (4) downloadReceipt revokes the blob URL in the same tick as click() on a detached anchor, which is a known cross-browser download-cancellation pattern; (5) window.open is called after an await inside togglePaid, so the popup is no longer strictly inside the user-gesture task and may be blocked by stricter browsers.
